title: Grateful Dead Live at Pelletier Farm on 1969-08-23
lineage: SBD > MC (Bear's) > Dick's Cass > DAT > CDR > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1969 show with standout Dark Star and Turn On Your Love Light, but marred by hiss and occasional mix quirks.
ai_review.review: The performance shines thanks to an expansive Dark Star, a fiery Turn On Your Love Light and a solid Hard to Handle, with Tom Constanten’s organ dominating the mix. While the soundboard source delivers moments of clarity, listeners must contend with hiss, low volume and a half‑step pitch shift that keep the recording from being pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and praise the musical highlights; technical complaints are present but do not outweigh the strong show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Organ (TC) sits unusually high in the mix; hiss, low volume and a half‑step pitch shift are noted. One reviewer mentions a mono switch mid‑song and a tape flip loss, but overall the sound is considered decent for a 1969 capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows through organ‑driven jams, with Dark Star providing a spacey centerpiece and the high‑energy rock of Hard to Handle keeping momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work praised in Hard to Handle; generally tight playing noted.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s organ is prominently mixed throughout and highlighted on Dark Star and other jams; Pigpen’s organ contributions (e.g., Turn On Your Love Light) are also celebrated.
